class.name: StreamingSource3D
class.brief_description: Position around which world content is streamed in.
class.description: Marks a position around which streamed content is kept loaded, typically the player character. For example, [Landscape3D] builds its collision (see [member Landscape3D.collision_radius]) around every [StreamingSource3D] of its world. When a world has no source, streaming systems use the active camera instead.

members.member: Priority of the content requested for this source, relative to the other sources.
Multiplier of the streaming distances (for example the collision radius of landscapes) around this source.
